conventions: Units are metres, degrees, seconds and kilograms. Light intensity is in candela for point and spot lights, lux for directional lights and the sun, and nits for area lights. Colour temperature is in kelvin.
Axes are right-handed with +Y up. An asset's front faces +Z in its own frame, as in glTF.
Yaw is a rotation about +Y in degrees. Yaw 0 means the front faces +Z; positive yaw turns +Z toward +X.
Transforms are local to the parent node, so children move with their parent.
An asset's origin is the centre of the bottom face of its bounding box, so pos[1] is the height of its base.
IDs are lowercase slugs (letters, digits, underscores) and are unique across the whole world file, including room openings.
Walls are written '<room_id>:<edge>'. Edge n runs from outline point n to point n+1.
Unknown fields are rejected. Put tool-specific data in an 'extras' field.

sections.title: Lowered scene
sections.intro: What lowering produces from a world file, and what both the validators and the Three.js loader read. Everything is flattened into simple items with world-space matrices; each item keeps the ID of the IR node it came from.

models.name: LoweredScene
models.summary: Everything the loader and the validators need, in world space.

fields.name: versions
fields.description: ir, lowering and three versions, for reproducible renders.

fields.name: bounds
fields.description: World [min, max] of all geometry.

models.name: ItemBase
models.summary: Fields every lowered item has.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique in the scene. Single-item nodes use the node ID; parts add '/part'.

fields.name: node
fields.description: ID of the IR node this came from.

fields.name: role
fields.description: What it is, e.g. 'asset', 'wall', 'floor', 'step', 'door', 'window'.

fields.name: matrix
fields.description: 4×4 world matrix, column-major (the order of Three.js Matrix4.elements).

fields.name: aabb

fields.description: Mesh material slot to lowered material ID.

fields.description: Flat shading, for a faceted low-poly look.

fields.description: Outline in local [x, z].

models.summary: Terrain heights on a regular grid centred on the item's origin.

fields.description: [width along x, depth along z] in metres.

fields.name: layer_materials

fields.description: Layer index at each vertex, same order as heights.
